verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's EC&VC page describes 'multi-jurisdictional support' as one of Europe's most active VC teams. It also documents a cross-border case study: German bank N26's billion-dollar round with US investors Third Point, Coatue and Dragoneer. Supporting evidence includes European venture-debt work, UK and DE cap-table templates, and offices across Europe, the US and Asia. Missing for 10: any documented flip or redomiciliation work, more than one concrete multi-jurisdiction financing case study, and independent corroboration beyond firm-authored pages.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings

citations.quote: we provide innovative and multi-jurisdictional support that helps our clients scale, attract investment and realise successful exits
Osborne Clarke advised N26, a German direct bank, in a billion-dollar funding round with top investors including Third Point, Coatue and Dragoneer.
